subject: Recap: Spend efficiency & pilot asks — BrightCart discovery
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Spend efficiency & pilot asks — BrightCart discovery

Hi Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned. I’ve copied Rishi (pricing) and Marissa (solutions) for visibility.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes for personalized recommendations during peak (P95 currently ~520ms) impacting conversion.
- High inference spend tied to large context windows and duplicated token generation across calls.
- Strict Q3 budget cap for new infra; procurement needs a 30–45 day runway.

Goals you stated
- Reduce per-transaction inference cost by ~50–65% while keeping P95 < 300ms.
- Pilot within US-region, preserve customer PII controls, and integrate with your Redis-based prefix cache.
- Clear success criteria: 20% conversion lift on recommendation CTR and <40% increase in total latency variance.

TCO levers we discussed (rough back-of-envelope numbers)
- Continuous batching: expected effective tokens per call reduction ~2.2–3.0x depending on traffic shape (conservative: 2.5x).
- Prefix/KV cache: repeated prompt prefixes projected to lower token emission by an additional ~15–25% for your flows.
- Quantized model variant: int8 option reduces GPU memory and enables denser packing; modest quality delta for recommendation prompts.
- Dedicated vs hosted: dedicated reserved capacity gives predictable unit costs for heavy steady workloads; hosted is quickest to pilot.

Example cost framing (illustrative)
- Current baseline (your estimate): $18k/mo for 300k inference calls with avg 1,800 tokens total.
- With Redwood hosted + batching + prefix cache: estimated $7–9k/mo (35–55% reduction).
- With Dedicated (reserved) + quantized model: estimated $5–6k/mo once steady throughput achieved.

Proposed pilot scope & timeline
1) Pilot scope: 100k calls/month initial (targeting high-impact recommendation segment), Redwood hosted with caching + batching enabled; optional quantized model variant for a canary group. (Owner: BrightCart / Soojin) — Start target: 6 Sept 2026
2) Success metrics: cost per conversion reduced, P95 latency < 300ms, no >1% quality regression on A/B baseline. (Owner: BrightCart / Marissa) — Evaluation at 30/60 days
3) Procurement/contract: 30–45 day procurement window, we’ll aim to provide a short TCO workbook and a pilot MSA draft. (Owner: Alex / Rishi)

Attachments I’m sending with this note:
- redwood_tco_onepager.pdf — quick snapshot of the cost levers and expected ranges.
- pilot_msa_draft.docx — short MSA and pilot terms (stubs).

Next steps (quick wins)
- Alex: confirm pilot cohort and any compliance checklist items we must meet for US data residency.
- Soojin: deliver TCO workbook and recommended config (by Thu 13 Aug).
- Rishi: provide pilot pricing options (hosted vs dedicated) and DocuSign-ready MSA (by Fri 14 Aug).

If anything above is off or we missed an ask, flag it and I’ll update. Happy to jump on a 20-min follow up if helpful.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap: Spend efficiency & pilot asks — BrightCart discovery

Thanks Soojin — very helpful summary. Couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Pilot cohort: we want to target the mobile checkout recommendations first (high conversion impact).
- Budget constraint: procurement can commit up to $15k for a 60-day pilot; anything above needs exec approval.
- Compliance: Priya will share our internal SOC2 evidence checklist; we need to ensure audit logs and access controls are available during the pilot.

Can you send the TCO workbook you mentioned and a stripped-down pilot statement of work with clear milestones? Procurement will need the one-pager + MSA to begin routing.

Also, curious what the expected P95 improvements look like once batching + cache are enabled — is 300ms P95 still achievable for mobile targets?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re hopeful this will fit into our Q3 test plan.

—Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Growth, BrightCart

Alex / Priya — quick follow up with the promised TCO workbook and a short answer on the P95 question. See the attached workbook (link below) and the one-pager for an executive view.

P95 expectation (practical answer)
- For the mobile checkout cohort, enabling continuous batching + prefix caching typically reduces CPU/GPU overhead and effective token load. In practice we’ve seen P95 improvement from ~450–600ms down to ~220–320ms on comparable recommendation workloads when batching parameters and cache TTLs are tuned. The conservative target remains P95 < 300ms; we’ll instrument and iterate during the first two weeks of the pilot.

TCO highlights (workbook summary)
- Expected hosted pilot cost (60 days, 100k calls): $5.5k–7k total depending on traffic shape (burstiness reduces batching efficiency).
- If you opt for a short reserved commitment (1–3 months) once pilot shows sustained throughput, projected monthly run-rate falls to $3.8–5.2k.

I’ve uploaded the workbook and the one-pager: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTCOWorkbook (see file: BrightCart_TCO_Workbook.xlsx)

Next step: Rishi will share a slim pricing option and a DocuSign MSA link. If procurement needs a formal SOW we can produce a 1-page SOW that maps to the pilot milestones above.

Thanks — will stand by for Priya’s checklist.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Alex — quick note from pricing. We built two slim options for the 60-day pilot (hosted):
Option A (Fast start, no reservation)
- Pilot fee: $6,200 (covers 100k calls, batching + prefix cache enabled)
- Overages: $0.0009 per extra token
- Support: Standard onboarding + 2 monitoring checks during pilot

Option B (Committed short-term, lower unit)
- Pilot fee: $4,400 (100k calls) with commitment to 1-month reserved capacity if metrics hit targets within pilot; reduced overage to $0.0006 per extra token
- Support: Priority onboarding + weekly tuning with Marissa

Both options assume US-region only and the listed success criteria in Soojin’s note. See the attached slim MSA and the pricing worksheet.

DocuSign for MSA: https://www.docusign.com/BRG-4721-ms
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/987654/deal/BRG-4721
